title: Wso2am: By default, StaxUtils placed no limit on the total number of elements or the total number of characters in an…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package arises from StaxUtils placing no limits by default on the total number of elements or characters in an XML document. This flaw can lead to denial of service conditions due to resource exhaustion. The issue affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 and has been assigned a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.5. Fixed versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 address this vulnerability.
